stories.title: No. 2 Oregon holds off Boise State in thriller
WVU retires record-setting QB White's No. 5 jersey
stories.summary: Pat White's record-setting career at West Virginia two decades ago came full circle when the school retired his No. 5 jersey.

stories.title: Dodgers hold Ohtani out of lineup 3rd straight day
stories.summary: Shohei Ohtani, who expressed soreness in his neck and along his right arm in Wednesday's 8-6 loss to the St. Louis Cardinals, is out of the Los Angeles Dodgers' lineup for a third straight game Saturday, but he has not yet been placed on the injured list.

stories.title: 'Sky's the limit' for Bama's Russell after debut win
stories.summary: Keelon Russell accounted for 335 yards and a touchdown as No. 13 Alabama opened the season with a 48-10 victory over East Carolina on Saturday.

stories.title: Ohio State rolls, set for 'monster game' at Texas
stories.summary: Ohio State coach Ryan Day said the top-ranked Buckeyes were already focused on next week's game vs. Texas moments after Saturday's season-opening 56-3 win over Ball State.
